* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Character: Gragra, Tatooine, U
|strategy=By Jedi Knight<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/gragra.html</ref>

A nice little Episode I alien, with standard Dark Side statistics. Gets a good power boost at Mos Espa though, making her well worth the 1 deploy!

Her text is almost a [[Projective Telepathy]] for deployment. For a cost of 1 Force, she forces the opponent to pay 2 more for a card with ability deployed to her site. A reasonably versatile way to fortify a site you need, and combined with [[Bad Feeling Have I]], a bit of a sting for Light Side mains!

The function is reminiscent of [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]]. Cheaper, and on a character, which adds versatility. But it only affects her site, and as a character, is vulnerable to being the first victim to a weapon shot.

As such, [[Gragra]] is best suited to decks where you want every trick to help fortify a single site... such as holding the Audience Chamber in a Scum & Villainy deck, or maybe the [[Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route (Desert){{!}}Desert]] Landing Site in a [[Maul]] deck drain theme.
